Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Aquatic] type trait.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly?

Effect: ＜Decode (Blue Lv.4)＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 level 4 blue Digimon card from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place 1 Digimon card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits from your hand as 1 of your Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
Inherited Effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
